market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: New People currently holds only 13 of 450 Duma seats. To gain the most seats, they would need a surge in support while larger parties remain stagnant or lose only a few seats. The Kremlin tightly controls the electoral process, and a minor pro-Kremlin project is unlikely to be allowed to outgain United Russia, which typically dominates seat gains. Historical election patterns show no precedent for such a small party achieving the highest net gain. The market's 28.2% implied probability appears substantially overpriced.
evidence_points: New People won 13 seats in 2021, representing a tiny fraction of the Duma.
United Russia commands a large majority and is expected to maintain its dominance through administrative resources.
No minor party has ever gained the most seats in a Russian Duma election; Kremlin projects are typically deployed to drain opposition votes, not to lead gains.
sources_consulted: Analysis of Russian electoral politics and Kremlin party management
